questions.title: Countdown From N With While Loop
questions.description:
Print integers from n down to 1, each on its own line, using a while loop.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
n lines, each containing one integer from n down to 1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
i = n
while i >= 1
  puts i
  i -= 1
end

questions.title: Sum One To N Using Until
questions.description:
Print the sum of integers from 1 to n (inclusive) using an until loop.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single integer, the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
i = 1
sum = 0
until i > n
  sum += i
  i += 1
end
puts sum

questions.title: Squares From One To N With For In
questions.description:
For each integer i from 1 to n (inclusive), print i squared, using a for in loop.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
n lines, each containing the square of i for i = 1..n.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
for i in 1..n
  puts i * i
end

questions.title: Multiples Of Seven With Times
questions.description:
Print the first n multiples of 7 (7, 14, 21, ..., 7*n), one per line, using the times iterator.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
n lines, each containing one multiple of 7.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
n.times do |i|
  puts 7 * (i + 1)
end

questions.title: Numbers Five To N With Upto
questions.description:
Print integers from 5 up to n (inclusive), each on its own line, using the upto iterator.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
Lines containing integers from 5 to n (inclusive), one per line.

Constraints:
5 <= n <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
5.upto(n) do |i|
  puts i
end

questions.title: List Array Elements With Each
questions.description:
Read n followed by n space-separated integers. Print each integer on its own line using the each iterator.

Input Format:
First line: integer n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
n lines, each containing one integer from the input list, in order.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000; -10000 <= value <= 10000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
arr = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
arr.each do |x|
  puts x
end

questions.title: Repeat Greeting K Times
questions.description:
Mariko is building a bot that welcomes users. Read a single-line greeting g followed by an integer k. Print the greeting k times, each on its own line, using the times iterator.

Input Format:
First line: greeting g (may contain spaces).
Second line: integer k.

Output Format:
k lines, each containing the greeting g.

Constraints:
1 <= k <= 1000
questions.output2:
Good morning
Good morning
Good morning
Good morning
Good morning
questions.sourcecode:
g = gets.chomp
k = gets.to_i
k.times do
  puts g
end

questions.title: Train Stops Announcement
questions.description:
A train route has m stops. Read m, then m lines each containing a stop name. Print "Next stop: <name>" for each stop in order, using the each iterator over the collected names.

Input Format:
First line: integer m.
Next m lines: stop names (one per line, may contain spaces).

Output Format:
m lines, each of the form "Next stop: <name>".

Constraints:
1 <= m <= 100
questions.sampleoutput1:
Next stop: Central
Next stop: Park
Next stop: Riverside
questions.sampleoutput2:
Next stop: North
Next stop: South
questions.output2:
Next stop: A
Next stop: B
Next stop: C
Next stop: D
questions.output3:
Next stop: Kyoto
Next stop: Osaka
questions.sourcecode:
m = gets.to_i
stops = []
m.times { stops << gets.chomp }
stops.each do |name|
  puts "Next stop: #{name}"
end

questions.title: Water Tank Fill Simulation
questions.description:
A water tank has capacity C liters. It currently holds R liters. Each minute exactly L liters are added. Using an until loop, print how many minutes elapse until the tank contains at least C liters.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated integers C R L.

Output Format:
A single integer, the number of minutes elapsed.

Constraints:
1 <= C <= 100000; 0 <= R <= C; 1 <= L <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
c, r, l = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
minutes = 0
until r >= c
  r += l
  minutes += 1
end
puts minutes

questions.title: Daily Savings Tracker
questions.description:
Mei starts with $0 saved. Each day she saves exactly D dollars. Using a while loop, count how many days pass until her total reaches or exceeds her goal G.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated integers G D.

Output Format:
A single integer, the number of days needed.

Constraints:
1 <= G <= 1000000; 1 <= D <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
g, d = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
total = 0
days = 0
while total < g
  total += d
  days += 1
end
puts days

questions.title: Inventory Restock Until Threshold
questions.description:
A warehouse currently has Q units of a product. The reorder threshold is T units. Each hour the supplier adds R units. Using an until loop (do not use a while loop), print how many hours elapse until the stock reaches or exceeds T.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated integers Q T R.

Output Format:
A single integer, the number of hours elapsed.

Constraints:
0 <= Q < T <= 1000000; 1 <= R <= 10000
questions.sourcecode:
q, t, r = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
hours = 0
until q >= t
  q += r
  hours += 1
end
puts hours

Input Format:

Output Format:
n lines, one entry per line, following FizzBuzz rules.

Constraints:

questions.title: Exam Pass Count With Each
questions.description:
A teacher has recorded scores of n students. A score of 40 or higher is a pass. Using the each iterator on the scores array, print the count of passing scores. Do not use count, select, filter, or partition.

Input Format:
First line: integer n.
Second line: n space-separated integer scores.

Output Format:
A single integer, the number of passing scores.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000; 0 <= score <= 100
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
scores = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
passes = 0
scores.each do |s|
  passes += 1 if s >= 40
end
puts passes

questions.title: Even Numbers One To N With For And Next
questions.description:
Print all even numbers from 1 to n (inclusive), one per line, using a for in loop with the next keyword to skip odd values. Do not use step, select, filter, or even?.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
Lines containing even integers from 2 up to n (or n-1 if n is odd), one per line.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 10000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
for i in 1..n
  next if i % 2 != 0
  puts i
end

questions.title: First Multiple Of Seven With Break
questions.description:
Read n followed by n space-separated integers. Print the first value in the list that is a multiple of 7, or -1 if no such value exists. Use the each iterator and the break keyword to stop early. Do not use find, detect, select, or first.

Input Format:
First line: integer n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
A single integer, the first multiple of 7 found, or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000; -10000 <= value <= 10000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
arr = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
result = -1
arr.each do |x|
  if x % 7 == 0
    result = x
    break
  end
end
puts result

questions.title: Reverse Countdown With Downto
questions.description:
Print integers from n down to 1, each on its own line, using the downto iterator. Do not use while, reverse, upto, or step.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
n lines, each containing one integer from n down to 1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
n.downto(1) do |i|
  puts i
end

questions.title: Prime Factorization With While Loop
questions.description:
Read a positive integer n >= 2. Using a while loop, compute its prime factorization and print it on a single line as base^exponent pairs separated by spaces, in ascending order of primes. For example, 60 = 2^2 * 3 * 5 prints "2^2 3^1 5^1". Do not use the Prime library, prime_division, or require.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single line of base^exponent pairs separated by single spaces.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 1000000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
parts = []
d = 2
while d * d <= n
  cnt = 0
  while n % d == 0
    n /= d
    cnt += 1
  end
  if cnt > 0
    parts << "#{d}^#{cnt}"
  end
  d += 1
end
if n > 1
  parts << "#{n}^1"
end
puts parts.join(" ")

questions.title: Collatz Sequence Steps To One
questions.description:
Read a positive integer n. Generate the Collatz sequence: while n is not 1, if n is even set n = n / 2, otherwise set n = 3 * n + 1. Count the number of steps taken. Print the step count. Do not use recursion, def, or lambda.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single integer, the number of steps until n becomes 1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
steps = 0
while n != 1
  if n.even?
    n = n / 2
  else
    n = 3 * n + 1
  end
  steps += 1
end
puts steps

questions.title: Sieve Of Eratosthenes Prime Count
questions.description:
Read integer n. Count how many primes are <= n using a Sieve of Eratosthenes. Use the each iterator to count true entries in the sieve. Do not use the Prime library, require, or find.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single integer, the count of primes <= n.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 100000
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
sieve = Array.new(n + 1, true)
sieve[0] = false
sieve[1] = false
2.upto(n) do |i|
  next unless sieve[i]
  break if i * i > n
  j = i * i
  while j <= n
    sieve[j] = false
    j += i
  end
end
count = 0
sieve.each do |flag|
  count += 1 if flag
end
puts count

questions.title: Number Diamond Pattern With While
questions.description:
Read integer n. Print a number diamond of 2*n - 1 rows. Row i (1..n) prints the integers 1 through i separated by spaces. Rows n+1 through 2n-1 print the integers 1 through (2n - i) separated by spaces. Use while loops only. Do not use times, each, or map.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
2*n - 1 lines, each containing space-separated integers from 1 up to the row's maximum value.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 20
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
row = 1
while row <= 2 * n - 1
  if row <= n
    k = row
  else
    k = 2 * n - row
  end
  line = []
  c = 1
  while c <= k
    line << c
    c += 1
  end
  puts line.join(" ")
  row += 1
end
